svg.title: Order flow
svg.desc: Nodes: Web app (client); Orders API (service); Orders database (database); Order events (queue); Stock API (service); Mailer (worker); Analytics (worker). Edges: Web app calls Orders API. Orders API calls Orders database. Orders API sends messages to Order events. Orders API calls Stock API across zones. Order events sends messages to Mailer. Order events sends messages to Analytics across regions.
